title: Switch --rate to open-loop arrivals and add p99.9
author: theo
head: theo/open-loop-arrivals

commits.message:
loadgen: open-loop runner with Poisson and constant arrivals

Requests go out on a schedule instead of when the previous response
comes back. Records keep intended_at next to sent_at (renamed from
start).

metrics: nearest-rank percentiles, add p99.9

Every reported number is a latency that really happened, and
statistics.quantiles(n=100) can't do p99.9.
cli: --rate runs the open loop; docs (decision 0005)

description_md:
**Why:** INC-2291. Engine pauses pushed customer TTFT p99 past 900 ms for three days and the nightly kiln-bench p99 didn't move. The closed loop stops sending while the engine is paused, so a pause only hits the few requests already in flight (coordinated omission; 0001 even called it out). Kenji wants to gate releases on kiln-bench (KLN-01), so this comes first.

**What:**
- `--rate` now runs an open loop (`openloop.py`): requests go out on a schedule, Poisson by default or `--arrival constant`, whatever the server does. Same idea as wrk2.
- Records carry `intended_at` (the scheduled send) next to `sent_at` (renamed from `start`), so latency now includes any time a request spent waiting to go out.
- In open-loop mode `--concurrency` caps requests in flight, so a stuck server can't make us open thousands of sockets.
- Percentiles are nearest-rank (every number is a latency that really happened, like HdrHistogram) and the report has p99.9 for the release gate. Wrote it by hand because `statistics.quantiles(n=100)` can't do p99.9.
- Not in this PR: trace replay, changing the closed-loop default for runs without `--rate`.

**How tested:**
- New `tests/test_openloop.py`; updated metrics/records/report/cli tests. CI green on Linux and macOS.
- INC-2291 repro on my laptop. Fake server: `kiln-bench fake-server --prefill-ms 20 --itl-ms 5 --pause-every 20 --pause-for 1` (one 1 s engine pause per 20 s), 20 s runs, `--max-tokens 8`.

Before (main, `--concurrency 4`):

```
918 requests in 20.01 s (45.9 ok/s), 0 errors
                 p50       p90       p99
TTFT (ms)       32.9      38.7      44.2
ITL (ms)         6.0       7.0       7.8
E2E (ms)        82.6      88.9      95.9
output tokens/s: 366.9
```

After (this branch, `--rate 40`):

```
669 requests in 20.05 s (33.4 ok/s), 0 errors
                 p50       p90       p99     p99.9
TTFT (ms)       25.3      28.1      33.1    1000.7
ITL (ms)         6.0       7.0       9.0      11.1
E2E (ms)        69.0      73.0      80.1    1065.5
output tokens/s: 267.0
```

p99.9 TTFT finally shows the 1 s pause, where the closed loop showed nothing. p50 also dropped a bit because we're not hammering it with 4 back-to-back workers anymore.

**Risk / rollout:** results files rename `start` to `sent_at`; `report` still reads old files. The regression bot only reads the summary JSON, which gains `p99.9` keys and loses nothing.

**Reviewer notes:** start with `openloop.py`, then `metrics.percentile`. Least sure about using `--concurrency` (default 4) as the in-flight cap; 4 felt safe for staging. @Luigi this is yours once it merges, so don't go easy on it.

**Follow-ups:** trace replay from recorded prompts; `--slo` flags so the release gate can fail a run.
